title: Service request
description: request.json in a run directory: one operation for the worker to run (packages/service/worker.py). A request this schema refuses still gets a result saying why.

request_id.description: The client's name for this request; every event and the result carry it back.

arguments.description: The operation's arguments; each operation refuses keys it does not take. Absent means {}.

design_revision.description: The design revision the client was showing, carried into the result.
